title: Octopus holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='13' ry='15' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <path d='M50 43 Q46 52 52 58' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#b06aff'/>

  <path d='M44 74 Q42 84 46 90' stroke='#9a55ee' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 74 Q58 84 54 90' stroke='#9a55ee' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q68 60 64 54 Q60 50 56 54' stroke='#b06aff' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='55' r='3' fill='#d4a8ff'/>
